description: The compiler follows every code path and computes the narrowed type of each reference at each position.
The declared type limits what can be assigned; the narrowed type is what the compiler knows at a given line.
A condition stored in a `const` (`const isText = typeof x === 'string'`) that still narrows when used later (TS 4.4+).
Narrowing inside callbacks is kept for `const` values and, since TS 5.4, for variables not reassigned after the closure is created.
